query: What reference materials, calibration workflows, and matrix-matching strategies ensure reliable XRF/XRD/ICP-MS/LA-ICP-MS for high-Fe, alkali-rich slags?

response.query: What reference materials, calibration workflows, and matrix-matching strategies ensure reliable XRF/XRD/ICP-MS/LA-ICP-MS for high-Fe, alkali-rich slags?
response.answer: For reliable XRF/XRD/ICP-MS/LA-ICP-MS analysis of high-Fe, alkali-rich slags, use certified reference materials, calibration with matrix-matched standards, and apply rigorous procedural controls. Matrix-matching strategies are crucial to minimize matrix effects.
